About us

Kordia is a leading provider of mission-critical technology solutions. Our expertise spans connectivity, infrastructure, cyber security, field services, media and broadcast; and safety of life services. Our team consists of almost 500 highly skilled consultants, cyber security analysts, field technicians, engineers; and sales and support staff - all of which are passionate about resolving problems and delivering smart solutions to our customers. We have a rich heritage in technology. For more than 65 years Kordia has been trusted to keep businesses connected. Kordia is also responsible for the network that monitors over 1/4 of the world’s oceans to ensure safety of life at sea. And, in an online world where cyber threats continue to rise at a rapid rate, Kordia is trusted to keep businesses safe online. We have the most comprehensive cyber security offering in New Zealand. Managed Cyber Security Services, a 24/7 Cyber Defence Operations, Managed Firewall, and expert advice from leading cyber-security consultants, Aura Information Security, are just some of the services we provide. Kordia is a state-owned enterprise. For more information visit: www.kordia.co.nz

    Kordia is proud to be monitoring world-first technology developed by Starboard Maritime Intelligence to protect New Zealand’s critical underwater infrastructure (CUI), such as telecommunications cables. These cables are vital to New Zealand’s security and resilience as they carry around 99 percent of our data traffic. The National Surveillance and Warning Capability was launched yesterday by the Associate Minister of Transport James Meager MP at Kordia’s Maritime Operations Centre (MOC) in Wellington. The breakthrough technology, a collaboration between the Government and industry, will trigger an alert to staff when vessel activity risks damaging nearby CUI. Thanks to Starboard Maritime Intelligence, James Meager MP, Christopher Bishop, Maritime New Zealand, Oceania Submarine Cable Association (OSCA) and the Ministry of Transport for supporting this important initiative at the launch yesterday. https://lnkd.in/eNP_WnUk

    Kordia is proud to be the only Darktrace Authorised partner in New Zealand and Australia, with members of our team Certified Cyber Security Analysts and Security Engineers. Thanks to Asish Thomas and the Kordia team for organising an Darktrace event on securing AI in our Auckland office last week. Being an authorised partner means our customers benefit from the full range of Managed Detection and Response (MDR) services powered by Darktrace's ActiveAl security platform. This can include faster threat detection, reduced response times and access to dedicated security professionals who can enhance your cybersecurity posture. https://lnkd.in/ezVsFwkM

    Asish Thomas
    1mo Edited

    Last week Kordia hosted a Darktrace event focused on “How to Secure Your AI in Your Organisation.” Really good turnout and some great conversations around what’s actually happening in the AI threat landscape right now, and how fast things are shifting. Interesting takeaways from the AI security discussion - AI threat landscape and how adversaries are already leveraging AI. - Importance of maintaining visibility and control while enabling AI innovation. - Darktrace Secure AI is helping organisations detect and respond to AI-driven threats in real time. - Kordia Managed Security Services & Incident Response in strengthening organisational resilience when it matters most. Thanks to everyone who came along and spent time with us, and for trusting Kordia as a security partner. Also proud that Kordia is the only Darktrace Authorised Partner in AU/NZ. Thanks to our speakers Tony Jarvis Conan Bradley Joel Featherstone and Mark Owen, and to Sektor New Zealand Sonapa Vickers Karthikeyan Ramakrishna Ross Cranston Bianca Edgar Abhijit (Abhi) Abhyankar Randy Ricaña for helping make the event happen. Also a big thank you to the amazing Kordia team for all the support in putting this together. Really appreciate the effort behind the scenes.
